  Special Meeting Minutes of January 15, 2020

6.  COMMITTEE BUSINESS AND DISCUSSION ITEMS

  Members of the public will be afforded an opportunity to comment and ask
  questions on each of the agenda items below but shall be limited to 2 minutes
  per person.

  A) Welcome New Enterprise Fund Committee
  B) Introductions of Utility Staff
  C) Brief Overview of Water and Sewer System
  D) Update on current CIP and upcoming Water Bond Jobs
  E) Request for Committee recommendations on the following items
  a. Electric vehicles (2)
  b. Hickson Mainline Replacement
  c. SCADA System
  d. Water Master Plan
  e. Reservoir Rehabilitation Construction MGT and Request for
  Services Proposal
  f. Organizational Chart (New Positions)

  7.  COMMITTEE COMMUNICATIONS
